All authorization/business policy externalized to OPA — none in code
>=90% unit-test coverage on new/changed code; tests live inside each logic point
Self-healing on core path: retries, circuit-breaking, graceful degradation, health/recovery hooks [resilience library to confirm — P-07]
Low-code: prefer reuse > configuration > extension point > new code
Standards adherence: naming, datatypes, field lengths, must-have fields
Configurable logo (TENANT.logoUrl) + client-pointable CSS (TENANT.cssOverrideUrl); multi-tenant theming
Tenancy key = client_id; isolation OPA-enforced (no RLS day one; RLS = future option)
Audit: metadata changes recorded to meta.metadata_change_history
If a standard is absent, ASK the SME — do not assume

subtasks.scope: React 18 + MUI + (AG Grid where tabular) components; Redux slice; calls service via API client; loading/error/empty states.
Consume TENANT.logoUrl + cssOverrideUrl theme primitives; brand-free tokens.

disposition_model.purpose: Against the existing Lextr Core codebase, each sub-task is first RESOLVED (does Core already satisfy this contract?) then classified, honoring low-code order reuse > configuration > extension > new.

states.UNRESOLVED: Not yet checked against Core. Default. Run the Phase-0 reconciliation prompt first.
states.REUSE: Core already satisfies this sub-task's contract as-is. Wire to it; write only the conformance test that proves the manifest's tests pass. Cannot be marked complete until that test passes.
states.ADAPT: Core has an adjacent asset that needs extension/configuration to meet the contract. Generate the reconciliation (map-gap-write) prompt, not a blank build.
states.BUILD: Nothing in Core satisfies this. Generate the standard build prompt.

disposition_model.lifecycle: UNRESOLVED -> (AI reports within the build/adapt prompt: searches repo, reports findings) -> REUSE|ADAPT|BUILD -> in-progress -> conformance/tests pass -> committed
disposition_model.reuse_gate: A REUSE sub-task may be marked committed ONLY after a conformance test demonstrating the manifest's tests_must_cover pass against the existing Core asset. (This is the one remaining hard gate; discovery itself is no longer a separate blocking step.)
disposition_model.propagation_note: Downstream-only: a REUSE/ADAPT decision conforms Core to the manifest contract or flags a gap; it never rewrites the manifest, DDL, or standards to match Core.

anti_duplication_contract.purpose: The development team exposes the live Lextr Core repo and branch to the AI. The governing risk is not 'does code exist' (the AI can see it) but that the AI authors a PARALLEL implementation instead of discovering and extending what exists. Duplication is the failure mode and is prohibited.
anti_duplication_contract.discovery_first: Discovery is folded INTO the single build/adapt prompt as its first required step — the AI searches the live repo/branch and reports SEARCHED/FOUND/DECISION before writing any code. There is no separate gating step the developer must run; the prompt itself makes discovery mandatory and self-reported. The disposition (REUSE/ADAPT/BUILD) is the AI's reported finding, not a pre-gate the developer sets by hand.
session_context: repo_url (or local path the team exposes)
branch (the exact branch exposed for this session)
hard_rules: Search the exposed repo and branch BEFORE writing anything.
If an existing controller, service, DAO, method, component, OPA package, or migration already covers this sub-task, EXTEND or CALL it — never author a parallel one.
Never create a second class, endpoint, table, column, or component that overlaps an existing one.
Before creating anything new, output: (a) the search terms/paths used, (b) what was found, (c) why nothing existing fits — the explicit reuse-vs-new decision with file paths.
Confine all reads and writes to the exposed branch's conventions and structure; do not introduce a parallel structure.
Downstream-only: conform Core to the manifest contract or flag a gap; never rewrite the manifest, DDL, or standards to match Core.
anti_duplication_contract.evidence_required: Every Phase-0 output must contain SEARCHED (terms+paths), FOUND (files+what they do), and DECISION (REUSE|ADAPT|BUILD with file paths). Build/adapt may proceed only after this evidence exists.
anti_duplication_contract.workflow_note: One prompt per sub-task. Its opening section forces the AI to (1) search the branch, (2) report what exists, (3) decide REUSE/ADAPT/BUILD with evidence, (4) for shared sub-tasks report cross-product impact — and only then write code, extending existing assets rather than duplicating. REUSE still completes only after a conformance test proves the manifest's tests pass.

product_estate.note: The Semantic Layer is a SHARED/COMMON component owned by Lextr Core and consumed by all products. Every Semantic-Layer point and sub-task is layer=shared and inherits tighter shared-layer governance. Repository topology (monorepo vs multi-repo vs shared package) is OPEN (P-10); layout is not assumed.

shared.definition: Component used across products; owned by Lextr Core; consumed by all. Wider blast radius.
rules: Cross-product regression expectation: a change is validated against all consuming products.
Independent deployability is the test: a shared change must not break any product's standalone deploy or couple products together.
A shared ADAPT/BUILD must state its cross-product impact (which products consume the asset; deploy impact).
A shared REUSE must confirm the existing asset's contract is the one ALL products rely on.

product_specific.definition: Code isolated to one product; independently deployable; a change does not affect other products.
rules: Standard review; no cross-product regression requirement.

ddl_ownership.team_owns: The team owns EXECUTING this DDL — applying it via Flyway to create/update the tables, in the manner the team defines. Full transparency: the complete DDL is embedded in the LP-01 work prompt so it is copy-run ready.
ddl_ownership.guardrail: Schema DESIGN changes flow upstream (downstream-only propagation): the team builds AGAINST this schema and does not unilaterally redesign it. A needed design change is raised as a gap to the owner (Lextr Core), not silently altered — because the Semantic Layer is shared across all products.
ddl_ownership.heading: Fixed contract — build against this; the team owns executing it (apply via Flyway). Schema design changes flow upstream, not made unilaterally.

-- =============================================================================
-- Lextr Semantic Layer — DDL (FIXED CONTRACT)
-- =============================================================================
-- Manifest version : 2.3.0
-- Standards Document: STANDARDS-DOC <to confirm>            (P-09)
-- Tech stack       : PostgreSQL 16 · SQL-first · Flyway-owned · no JPA
-- Tenancy          : client_id (OPA-enforced isolation; Postgres RLS = future option)
-- Graph store      : Neo4j is the projection of relationship/lineage data;
--                    PostgreSQL is the system of record (this file).
-- Authorization    : externalized to OPA — NO policy logic in schema (no RLS day one)
-- Layer            : SHARED / COMMON. This schema is owned by Lextr Core and CONSUMED
--                    by all products (Lextr Core, Lextr Intelligence, Lextr EUC
--                    Remediation). A change here has cross-product blast radius and is
--                    governed more tightly: cross-product regression expected; a change
--                    must preserve every product's independent deployability.
-- Repo topology    : OPEN (monorepo vs multi-repo vs shared package — P-10). This file
--                    does not assume a layout; where it lands is a packaging decision.
-- =============================================================================
-- RING-FENCED CONTRACT. The build team builds AGAINST this schema and MUST NOT
-- alter it. Schema/standards are owned upstream (here) and flow downstream only.
-- Apply via Flyway as a versioned migration (e.g. V1__semantic_layer_baseline.sql).
-- =============================================================================
-- STANDARDS THIS DDL CONFORMS TO
--   Naming     : snake_case; schema.object.column; logical_short_nm <= 32 chars
--   Datatype   : canonical suffix vocabulary —
--                _cd CODE | _id IDENTIFIER | _amt AMOUNT | _rate RATE numeric(16,8)
--                _pct PERCENTAGE | _dt DATE | _ts TIMESTAMP | _flg/_ind BOOLEAN
--                _nbr NUMBER | _nm NAME | _txt free text
--   Must-have  : every table carries created_ts, created_by; mutable tables add
--                updated_ts, updated_by; governed tables add lifecycle_status_cd
--   Tenancy    : client_id varchar(40) present on tenant-scoped tables (nullable
--                = GLOBAL row); isolation enforced in OPA, not RLS (day one)
--   Taxonomy   : taxonomy_cd varchar(12); jurisdiction validation in OPA, not CHECK
-- Assumptions flagged inline as: -- [ASSUMED] ... (confirm against Standards Doc)
-- =============================================================================

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SCHEMAS  (Semantic Layer subset — all PostgreSQL)
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS meta;          -- semantic catalog (system of record)
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS governance;    -- governance presets (DB-driven values)
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS ref;           -- reference / regulatory reference data
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS report;        -- regulatory report structure
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS wkfl;          -- approval workflow

-- ============================================================================
-- meta.schema_catalog — registered schemas
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE meta.schema_catalog (
    schema_cd            varchar(30)  PRIMARY KEY,
    schema_nm            varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    schema_purpose_txt   text,
    lifecycle_status_cd  varchar(30)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
    created_ts           timestamptz  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    created_by           varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user,
    updated_ts           timestamptz,
    updated_by           varchar(100),
    CONSTRAINT ck_sc_lifecycle CHECK (lifecycle_status_cd IN
        ('DRAFT','REVIEW','APPROVED','ACTIVE','DEPRECATED','RETIRED'))
);

-- ============================================================================
-- meta.data_connection — connection registry (per-object engine routing)
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE meta.data_connection (
    connection_id        uuid         PRIMARY KEY,
    connection_cd        varchar(50)  NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    connection_nm        varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    engine_cd            varchar(30)  NOT NULL,          -- POSTGRES | CLICKHOUSE | NEO4J
    connection_type_cd   varchar(30)  NOT NULL,
    source_mode_cd       varchar(30)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'METADATA_PLUS_EXECUTION',
    host_nm              varchar(200),
    port_nbr             integer,
    database_nm          varchar(100),
    schema_nm_default    varchar(100),
    is_default_flg       boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    is_active_flg        boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    secrets_ref          varchar(200),                   -- Vault/KMS key reference only
    created_ts           timestamptz  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    created_by           varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user,
    updated_ts           timestamptz,
    updated_by           varchar(100),
    CONSTRAINT ck_dc_engine CHECK (engine_cd IN ('POSTGRES','CLICKHOUSE','NEO4J'))
);

-- ============================================================================
-- meta.object_catalog — registered semantic objects
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE meta.object_catalog (
    id                              bigserial    PRIMARY KEY,
    schema_cd                       varchar(30)  NOT NULL
        REFERENCES meta.schema_catalog (schema_cd),
    object_cd                       varchar(50)  NOT NULL,
    object_nm                       varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    object_type_cd                  varchar(50)  NOT NULL,
    object_desc                     text,
    object_purpose_txt              text,
    primary_business_process_txt    text,
    grain_txt                       text,
    source_system_cd                varchar(50),
    source_object_nm                varchar(100),
    refresh_frequency_cd            varchar(50),
    retention_policy_txt            text,
    partition_strategy_txt          text,
    row_count_approx                bigint,
    connection_id                   uuid REFERENCES meta.data_connection (connection_id),
    data_classification_cd          varchar(30),
    ai_governance_cd                varchar(50),
    pii_flg                         boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    confidential_flg                boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    semantic_layer_enabled_flg      boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    ai_approved_flg                 boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    lineage_enabled_flg             boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    dependency_graph_enabled_flg    boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    client_id                       varchar(40),                   -- NULL = GLOBAL
    lifecycle_status_cd             varchar(30)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
    governance_review_status_cd     varchar(30)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    standards_validation_status_cd  varchar(30)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    version_nbr                     integer      NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_ts                      timestamptz  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    created_by                      varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user,
    updated_ts                      timestamptz,
    updated_by                      varchar(100),
    CONSTRAINT uq_object   UNIQUE (schema_cd, object_cd),
    CONSTRAINT ck_ob_type  CHECK (object_type_cd IN
        ('TABLE','VIEW','MATERIALIZED_VIEW','SEMANTIC_VIEW',
         'FUNCTION','PROCEDURE','SEQUENCE','EXTERNAL_TABLE')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_ob_data_class CHECK (data_classification_cd IN
        ('PUBLIC','INTERNAL','CONFIDENTIAL','RESTRICTED')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_ob_ai_gov CHECK (ai_governance_cd IN
        ('AI_ALLOWED','AI_RESTRICTED','AI_PROHIBITED',
         'SLM_ONLY','STRICT_AI_GOVERNANCE','POLICY_DRIVEN')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_ob_lifecycle CHECK (lifecycle_status_cd IN
        ('DRAFT','REVIEW','APPROVED','ACTIVE','DEPRECATED','RETIRED'))
);
CREATE INDEX ix_oc_schema   ON meta.object_catalog (schema_cd);
CREATE INDEX ix_oc_client   ON meta.object_catalog (client_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_oc_status   ON meta.object_catalog (lifecycle_status_cd);

-- ============================================================================
-- meta.attribute_catalog — attributes per object  (carries Taxonomy/MDRM)
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE meta.attribute_catalog (
    id                          bigserial    PRIMARY KEY,
    schema_cd                   varchar(30)  NOT NULL,
    object_cd                   varchar(50)  NOT NULL,
    attribute_cd                varchar(32)  NOT NULL,
    physical_attribute_nm       varchar(32)  NOT NULL,
    source_attribute_nm         varchar(100),
    logical_short_nm            varchar(32),                       -- <= 32 (standard)
    logical_long_nm             text,
    semantic_attribute_nm       text,
    attribute_desc              text,
    attribute_purpose_txt       text,
    canonical_data_type_cd      varchar(50)  NOT NULL,
    source_data_type_cd         varchar(50),
    postgresql_data_type_cd     varchar(50),
    clickhouse_data_type_cd     varchar(50),
    semantic_group_cd           varchar(50),
    ordinal_position            integer,
    nullable_flg                boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    pk_flg                      boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    fk_flg                      boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    -- ---- Taxonomy / MDRM (first-class; jurisdiction validation in OPA) ----
    taxonomy_cd                 varchar(12),                       -- MDRM/Taxonomy
    taxonomy_source_cd          varchar(20),                       -- REG_DEFINED | LEXTR_ASSIGNED
    taxonomy_jurisdiction_cd    varchar(10),                       -- USA | non-USA ISO
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    dq_criticality_cd           varchar(30),
    regulatory_criticality_cd   varchar(30),
    regulatory_item_ref_txt     varchar(100),                      -- free-text citation
    pii_flg                     boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    confidential_flg            boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    masking_policy_cd           varchar(50),
    ai_business_context_txt     text,
    ai_prompt_guidance_txt      text,
    ai_relationship_context_txt text,
    ai_risk_audit_context_txt   text,
    ai_governance_context_txt   text,
    ai_example_txt              text,
    version_nbr                 integer      NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_ts                  timestamptz  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    created_by                  varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user,
    updated_ts                  timestamptz,
    updated_by                  varchar(100),
    CONSTRAINT uq_attribute UNIQUE (schema_cd, object_cd, attribute_cd),
    CONSTRAINT fk_attr_object FOREIGN KEY (schema_cd, object_cd)
        REFERENCES meta.object_catalog (schema_cd, object_cd) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT ck_attr_tax_source CHECK (taxonomy_source_cd IS NULL OR taxonomy_source_cd IN
        ('REG_DEFINED','LEXTR_ASSIGNED'))
    -- [ASSUMED] taxonomy_cd length rule (USA reg=8, Lextr=8, non-USA=12) is enforced
    --           in OPA at registration, NOT as a DB CHECK, because the rule is
    --           jurisdictional/business policy and policy is externalized. Confirm.
);
CREATE INDEX ix_ac_object   ON meta.attribute_catalog (schema_cd, object_cd);
CREATE INDEX ix_ac_taxonomy ON meta.attribute_catalog (taxonomy_cd);

-- ============================================================================
-- meta.semantic_relationship_catalog — governed joins (PG system of record;
--    projected into Neo4j for traversal/visualization)
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE meta.semantic_relationship_catalog (
    id                      bigserial    PRIMARY KEY,
    relationship_cd         varchar(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    parent_schema_cd        varchar(30)  NOT NULL,
    parent_object_cd        varchar(50)  NOT NULL,
    parent_attribute_cd     varchar(32)  NOT NULL,
    child_schema_cd         varchar(30)  NOT NULL,
    child_object_cd         varchar(50)  NOT NULL,
    child_attribute_cd      varchar(32)  NOT NULL,
    relationship_type_cd    varchar(30)  NOT NULL,
    cardinality_cd          varchar(20)  NOT NULL,
    join_type_cd            varchar(20)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INNER',
    is_enforced_flg         boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    is_nullable_flg         boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    is_cross_engine_flg     boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    relationship_desc       text,
    ai_join_guidance_txt    text,
    neo4j_synced_ts         timestamptz,                       -- last projection to Neo4j
    lifecycle_status_cd     varchar(30)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
    created_ts              timestamptz  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    created_by              varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user,
    updated_ts              timestamptz,
    updated_by              varchar(100),
    CONSTRAINT ck_rel_card CHECK (cardinality_cd IN
        ('ONE_TO_ONE','ONE_TO_MANY','MANY_TO_ONE','MANY_TO_MANY'))
);
CREATE INDEX ix_rel_parent ON meta.semantic_relationship_catalog (parent_schema_cd, parent_object_cd);
CREATE INDEX ix_rel_child  ON meta.semantic_relationship_catalog (child_schema_cd, child_object_cd);

-- ============================================================================
-- meta.attribute_logical_name_override — governed per-attribute rename
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE meta.attribute_logical_name_override (
    id                   bigserial    PRIMARY KEY,
    schema_cd            varchar(30)  NOT NULL,
    object_cd            varchar(50)  NOT NULL,
    attribute_cd         varchar(32)  NOT NULL,
    override_nm          varchar(32)  NOT NULL,                  -- <= 32
    override_reason_txt  text,
    override_status_cd   varchar(30)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    workflow_task_id     bigint,
    requested_by         varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user,
    requested_ts         timestamptz  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    approved_by          varchar(100),
    approved_ts          timestamptz,
    CONSTRAINT ck_lno_status CHECK (override_status_cd IN ('PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED')),
    CONSTRAINT fk_lno_attr FOREIGN KEY (schema_cd, object_cd, attribute_cd)
        REFERENCES meta.attribute_catalog (schema_cd, object_cd, attribute_cd) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- ============================================================================
-- meta.semantic_filter_lookup — reusable governed value sets (two-phase semi-join)
-- ============================================================================
CREATE TABLE meta.semantic_filter_lookup (
    id                          bigserial    PRIMARY KEY,
    lookup_cd                   varchar(60)  NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    construction_type_cd        varchar(20)  NOT NULL,             -- SQL_QUERY | MANUAL_LIST
    manual_subtype_cd           varchar(30),                       -- ATTRIBUTE_VALIDATED | HAND_TYPED
    filter_obj                  varchar(120),
    filter_condition_txt        text,
    filter_attr_cd              varchar(32),
    validation_obj              varchar(120),
    validation_attr_cd          varchar(32),
    suggested_target_attr_cd    varchar(32),
    execution_strategy_cd       varchar(20)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IN_LIST',
    max_input_set_size          integer      NOT NULL DEFAULT 500,
    max_output_rows             integer      NOT NULL DEFAULT 10000,
    cache_ttl_min               integer      NOT NULL DEFAULT 60,
    review_period_days_override integer,
    rules_eligible_flg          boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    qs_eligible_flg             boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    ai_eligible_flg             boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    replicate_to_ch_flg         boolean      NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    description_txt             text,
    client_id                   varchar(40),                       -- NULL = GLOBAL
    governance_status_cd        varchar(30)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
    health_status_cd            varchar(30)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    last_certified_ts           timestamptz,
    last_certified_by           varchar(100),
    next_review_due_dt          date,
    lifecycle_status_cd         varchar(30)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
    created_ts                  timestamptz  NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    created_by                  varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user,
    updated_ts                  timestamptz,
    updated_by                  varchar(100),
    CONSTRAINT ck_fl_ctype  CHECK (construction_type_cd IN ('SQL_QUERY','MANUAL_LIST')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_fl_sub    CHECK (manual_subtype_cd IS NULL OR manual_subtype_cd IN
        ('ATTRIBUTE_VALIDATED','HAND_TYPED')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_fl_strat  CHECK (execution_strategy_cd IN
        ('IN_LIST','BLOOM_FILTER','BRIDGE_TABLE')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_fl_gov    CHECK (governance_status_cd IN ('DRAFT','REVIEW','ACTIVE','SUSPENDED'))
);
CREATE INDEX ix_fl_client ON meta.semantic_filter_lookup (client_id);
CREATE INDEX ix_fl_health ON meta.semantic_filter_lookup (health_status_cd);

    id                      bigserial    PRIMARY KEY,
    lookup_cd               varchar(60)  NOT NULL
        REFERENCES meta.semantic_filter_lookup (lookup_cd) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    value_cd                varchar(100) NOT NULL,
    value_desc              text,

    workflow_ref            varchar(60),

correction_feedback.purpose: A developer/reviewer correction to AI-generated code must not evaporate at session end. It feeds back at three time-scales and routes by class, so the manifest learns and the next prompt is pre-corrected.

time_scales.within_sub_task: At completion the work prompt requires the AI to emit an ADJUSTMENTS record: what was corrected, why, and a CLASS tag (IMPLEMENTATION|CONTRACT|STANDARD|DECISION).
time_scales.across_session: Prompt generation READS the session's accumulated corrections + the sub-task's adjustments[] BEFORE producing the next prompt, so a correction made on one sub-task is already applied to the next. The generator never re-issues a prompt that repeats an already-corrected mistake.
time_scales.into_manifest: Corrections persist durably in the manifest JSON (working memory) and the gate-log (audit memory), routed by class.

routing_by_class.IMPLEMENTATION: Auto-applied to the manifest JSON (pre_build_knowledge / reuse candidates / sub-task notes updated). Written to the gate-log with details; owner is notified.
routing_by_class.CONTRACT: NOT auto-applied. Written as a PROPOSAL to the owner (SME / Data Authority) and held until approved.
routing_by_class.STANDARD: NOT auto-applied. Written as a PROPOSAL and held until approved.
routing_by_class.DECISION: NOT auto-applied. Written as a PROPOSAL and held until approved.

correction_feedback.ring_fence_note: Routing preserves downstream-only propagation: a build correction can never silently rewrite the data model, standards, or a fixed decision. Only IMPLEMENTATION corrections auto-apply; the other three classes require owner approval.

homes.manifest_json: Working memory the AI reads to generate the next prompt: per sub-task adjustments[] + a session-level corrections log + a proposals list.
homes.gate_log: Audit memory + owner notification. Same correction written here too.

viewer_boundaries.notification: A viewer-only console cannot SEND notifications. It records corrections with owner_notified=true and flags proposals prominently in the CORRECTIONS view; real email/Slack notification is a backend hook, not a manifest change.
viewer_boundaries.persistence: Console correction state is in-session (like the commit board); the durable home is the manifest JSON, regenerated/committed through the normal flow.
